title: How much of the square is the band?
description: A diagonal cuts a square into two equal triangles, and a second line parallel to it cuts a small triangle off one corner. The shaded band is what is left of the half after that corner triangle is taken away. Keeko thinks the whole half is the band.
teaching_notes: One idea: the shaded band is a part taken away from a part, so find the corner piece as a fraction of the whole square and subtract it. Watch for students who count the whole triangle on one side of the diagonal as the band.

source: A big square has one diagonal drawn from its top-left corner to its bottom-right corner. A second line is drawn parallel to it from the middle of the left side to the middle of the bottom side. The band between the two parallel lines is shaded. What fraction of the big square is shaded?
video_script.why: A learner finds a corner piece as a fraction of a fraction, and then takes it away from the half to find the band.
video_script.substitution: the book's own big square with a diagonal and a second line parallel to it
video_script.anchor: a big square with a diagonal, a parallel line from the middle of the left side to the middle of the bottom side, and a shaded band between them
video_script.wrong_move: takes the whole triangle below the diagonal as the band and forgets the corner triangle cut off by the second line
video_script.payoff_line: Three eighths of the big square is shaded.

final_answer.spoken: three eighths of the big square

video_script.fraction_reading: half, one quarter, one eighth, four eighths, three eighths
maths_rules: the diagonal cuts the big square into two equal triangles, so the bottom-left triangle = 1/2 of the big square
the corner triangle has short sides equal to half the side of the big square, so four such triangles fill the bottom-left triangle; the corner triangle = 1/4 of the bottom-left triangle
corner triangle = 1/4 x 1/2 = (1 x 1)/(4 x 2) = 1/8 of the big square
the slip: counting the whole bottom-left triangle, 1/2
video_script.design: The big square with the diagonal; the bottom left triangle is cut into four equal small triangles by lines joining the middles of its sides, and one of them is the corner piece.
